Forest Conservation Ordinance

THE order under sub section 3(1) that has to be read with sub section 4(1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of the powers vested in me under sub section 3(1) that has to be read with sub section 4(1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation do by this Order declare the state lands of the extent 404.0 hectares bounded by the limits set forth in the Schedule hereto as Sammugapuram Reserved Forest from 29th day of August 2024.
Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.
Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation,No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,29th day of August, 2024.

SCHEDULE

The state land of 404.0 hectares located within Vengalacheddikulam Divisional Secretary Division of Vavuniya District in the Northern Province of Sri Lanka located within the area depicted by the following geodesic coordinates (Survey method – Geodesic coordinates EPSG: 5234 method).

The land area surrounded by the straight lines formed by joining the starting point (Eastern Coordinates 151619, Northern Coordinates 388165) up to the final point (Eastern Coordinates 151243, Northern Coordinates 388113) and from there again up to the starting point (Eastern Coordinates 151619, Northern Coordinates 388165).
Extent - 404.0 hectares
FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
Notification

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Sammugapuram Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is subjected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.

Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation,No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,29th day of August, 2024.
